scope: Uninstrumented portable X11 settings, wallet table, native receive QR/copy, on-demand send form, middle-click tab closing, validation feedback, password-only generation, import, encrypted backup, restart and fresh-profile restore; disposable generated and public fixture roots only

steps.name: short-password-feedback
password-mismatch-feedback
Explicit first-run password-only generation and Main account overview without phrase reveal
Verified owner-only encrypted backup in ordinary 0755 folder without folder mutation or lockfile
existing-backup-feedback
unsafe-backup-folder-feedback
Rejected backups preserve existing ciphertext and leave the active wallet usable
Password-only generated root restored from verified encrypted backup into an empty profile
invalid-recovery-phrase-feedback
Native input-only BIP39 import with production KDF
Native encrypted portable backup creation and reopen verification
Go-owned verified receive QR and exact independent public address
Wallet table copy icon invokes native verification and copies the full independent public address
Receive popup shows authoritative QR and full address with explicit in-window native copying
Table row opens a wallet tab; Receive uses its own window and Send reveals its form on demand
Middle-click closes the active wallet tab and returns to its account table
Restart requires native unlock and preserves deterministic address
Portable restore into empty profile without original application state
Explicit testnet profile starts empty and preserves existing mainnet ciphertext without conversion
Additional deterministic account appears as its own top tab with index-one network wallets
Captured logs and persisted profile files contain no tested secret canaries
Invalid native inputs and backup failures produce guidance without ordinary IPC handler stack traces or Mesa loader errors
